Whether you need to repair your roof or replace it, T-Rock Roofing & Contracting is committed to completing the job quickly, efficiently, and with as little stress as possible. We work hard to minimize disruptions to your daily routine while delivering high-quality workmanship. As the Rolex of Roofing serving Dallas homeowners and business owners, we tailor our solutions to best fit your needs. T-Rock Roofing & Contracting offers a wide range of roofing and construction services, including roof repair, new roof installation, hail damage restoration, storm damage repair, and fire damage restoration. data.summary: The company has strong credentials (BBB A+, 18 years). However, the available review data is insufficient and suspicious. The Google reviews are not credible customer testimonials. The Yelp rating is high but the review content was not provided for analysis. There is a lack of detailed, authentic customer narratives to assess service quality or complaint patterns.
fake_signals: Google reviews are generic, anonymous, and lack detail
Google review text appears to be business description, not customer experience
Extremely low review volume (3) on Google for an 18-year-old business
No substantive negative or constructive feedback found
authentic_signals: BBB A+ rating and long accreditation (since 2010)
Yelp shows a substantial review count (32) with a high rating
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google Maps HQ shows a perfect 5.0 rating but with only 3 total reviews, all of which are generic and anonymous. This contrasts with the more established Yelp rating of 4.8 from 32 reviews and the long-standing BBB A+ accreditation. The Google reviews lack substance and appear to be placeholders.
